instruction:
Compare vllm-project/vllm, ggml-org/llama.cpp, and sgl-project/sglang on GitHub. Record stars, forks, and open issue counts for each repository, then present the results in a table and rank repositories by stars.

Stopping condition: Stop after all nine metrics, repository names, and the star ranking have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not star, fork, clone, comment, or modify repositories.
